description.en: The type is the picture: big, tight letters that run off the frame, with one orange accent.
description.tr: Yazının kendisi görsel: büyük, sıkı, kadraja taşan harfler ve tek turuncu vurgu.

colorRules.accent: one word, symbol or arrow per scene: the word the speaker stresses

display.use: all on-screen type. Width is a design and animation variable.

widths.rule: mix at most two widths per scene: one extended word against condensed words

layout.scale: the hero word fills or overflows the frame, it may be cropped by the frame edges
layout.align: left or flush to frame edges, never centered

wordIn.from: slide in from a frame edge or rise from a mask line

widthMorph.use: stressed word stretches from condensed to extended

swap.use: hard cut between words on beat, no crossfade

exit.to: slide out through the nearest frame edge

motion.sync: every word appears on its transcript timestamp, stressed word on the stressed syllable
